speaker: Patient
text: The pain feels like a tight band squeezing my chest and often shoots down into my jaw and left arm. speaker: Doctor
text: I must clarify that your symptoms of chest pressure radiating to the jaw and arm, triggered by exertion, are classic signs of cardiac ischemia, not sepsis.
